messages:
camila: dropping a quick check on the escalation preview in the SLO editor. added compact legend + focused announce region. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ZZZZ/escalation-preview
rachel: looks good. small UX ask: when a channel will escalate, show a concise badge 'escalates' not just color. some PMs miss color-only cues.
paz: +1. also suggest the screenreader string be short: 'Will notify: PagerDuty (2), Email (1). Escalates: PagerDuty.' keeps it scannable.
liz: accessibility: ensure the announce region uses aria-live="polite" and only fires on settled values (not every drag delta). keyboard users should get a single summary after they finish adjusting.
aria-bot: a11y tip: use debounce of 150ms before updating aria-live to avoid flooding; provide aria-describedby linking the slider to the preview summary.
camila: interaction detail: add focusable suppressed channel entries with a small muted icon and link to quiet-window settings. tooltip must appear on focus.
rachel: visual nits: legend colors for small labels need contrast. darken the orange or add a bold outline for the badge text.
camila: ok i'll update figma with: badge copy, aria-live debounce, focusable suppressed items, and contrast tweak. will post new frames in ~90 mins. :sparkles:
